text:
maria: Heads-up: CVE-2026-12345 in libfasthttp. Affects our Dedicated + Private images that bundle fasthttp v1.2.2. We need a backport plan for customers running VPC/on‑prem with pinned images. Who picks this up?
kevin: I can take ownership of the backport PR and image build. We need to decide: per-customer image tags vs patch branches + signed manifests. Constraints: some customers are air‑gapped so we must be able to deliver tarballs.
jules: Prefer: backport the fix into the appropriate release branch (release/2025.12), build patched images, and publish signed manifests to our registry. For air‑gapped/private customers provide image tar + verification sig. We cannot push into customer registries.
sora: Note: a few regulated customers require images to be built inside their network and signed with their KMS/HSM. For those we'll need to provide a reproducible build recipe + binary diff or layer tar, plus a verification hash.
anna: Triage note: CVE-2026-12345 = RCE via malformed HTTP headers parsing, CVSS high, exploit proof-of-concept exists. Priority: P1 for Dedicated hosted customers; P0 for Private/regulatory/air‑gapped customers. Patch and backport asap.
ci-bot: Backport template: please include changelog entry, security justification, and add labels `security/backport` and `cve/CVE-2026-12345`. CI will run: unit -> smoke -> canary deploy job. Example command:
```
make backport BRANCH=release/2025.12 CVE=CVE-2026-12345
```
kevin: Steps I'm planning:
```
git checkout -b backport/CVE-2026-12345 release/2025.12
# cherry-pick fix commit abcdef1
make build-image IMG_TAG=redwood/dedicated:2025.12-cve-2026-12345
# produce manifest and sign
gpg --detach-sign --armor image-manifest.json
```
jules: Testing matrix: unit, integration, e2e with KMS-mock, audit-log smoke tests, perf smoke (99p latency). Gate: all green + canary run for 24h with health checks. For private customers require additional acceptance test run inside their infra (we'll coordinate).
sora: For customers that build in-situ: we'll hand off `build-artifacts.tar.gz` (layers + Dockerfile + manifest) and a `verify.sh` script that checks SHA256 and signature. Provide KMS integration docs: how to sign using AWS KMS / GCP KMS / local HSM.
maria: Rollout plan: canary to 3 low-risk Dedicated clusters, monitor errors/latency/audit logs. If stable, push to all Dedicated. For Private: coordinate per-customer schedule — some customers will want delayed rollout.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: canary/dedicated/cve-2026-12345 -> cluster canary-1 (job id: deploy-8992).
anna: Action items:
- kevin: create backport PR + build patched images + upload signed manifests (owner)
- jules: define exact test matrix and gating thresholds (owner)
- maria: draft advisory + customer comms (owner)
- sora: provide list of customers requiring in-situ builds and KMS constraints (owner)
I'll draft CVE advisory language and coordinate with Legal for disclosures.
kevin: Starting PR now, ETA ~6h for an initial patched image build. Will post PR link here.
jules: I'll schedule the canary run for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need a manual trigger for private customer acceptance tests. :eye:
maria: Thanks everyone. @sora can you post the customer list and indicate which require HSM signing by EOD? :pray:
sora: Sending list in a follow-up message (CSV with customer id, env-type, signing requirement).
maria: Tracking ticket INF-2891 created for end-to-end tracking. I'll update as things progress.
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/compare/backport/CVE-2026-12345 (work-in-progress)
anna: Keep the advisory text tight: include mitigation steps (upgrade images, disable feature X if immediate mitigation needed). We'll confirm wording before customer send.
maria: Closing loop for now — follow-ups in INF-2891 and the PR.
